title: 第747章 剑经第746章 拒绝了
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 帝兵在中州并不是特别少见。
尤其是低阶帝兵。
凡是稍微有点钱的，都能买上一把。
典当自己的宝器，那可真是太过于穷酸了。
方离秋越是想着林玄，眼神中的排斥和不屑越是几乎能溢出来，根本就不觉得，对方会是什么自己惹不得的人物。
笑话。
沧澜城又不是什么大城。
玲珑阁的东西，更是价格稀疏平常。
连几颗丹药都买不起，不是穷酸散修是什么？
不识好歹，是对方的问题！
反而是秦媚儿眼睛一下子亮了。
她整个人的眉眼瞬间变得活灵活现，朝着方离秋露出来一个嘲弄的笑容，笑嘻嘻开口。
“哈哈哈，方离秋，你这套也就对你方家的狗有用，凡是有点风骨的人，都不会眼巴巴凑上去被你驱使，还真以为灵石无所不能了？笑死人了。”
得她如此一句，方离秋被气的恨恨剜了她一眼，冷脸直接甩手离开。
只剩秦媚儿一人，仿佛是打了胜仗似的，得意的哼了一声。
但她并未就此息事宁人离开，反而是望向管事，靠着柜台随意敲了敲。
“把他留下的那一枚宝器给我。”
管事不敢有任何异议，将林玄留下的宝器交出。
双鱼玉佩呈现出通体温润的乳白色，在阳光的照耀下熠熠生辉，触摸它，仿佛还能感受到男子冰凉的体温。
秦媚儿的眉眼弯弯。
这人，还真有意思……
宁折不弯嘛？
她倒是真心想要结识一下他了。
想着，她果断一甩手，将玉佩收下，朝着旁边欲言又止的管事摆摆手。
“在我的月例里面扣就是了。”
“这东西，我就拿走了。”
红色的裙角擦过一阵香风离开，被搁置的管事却只觉得松了一口去，他忙不迭点头。
“恭送媚儿小姐。”
离开的林玄，根本就没有将这个小插曲放在心上。
但是不得不说，缺少灵石，对于他来说，也真的是一件相当麻烦的事情。
回到自己在沧澜城临时的住处之后，林玄坐于院内的槐花树青石桌旁，微微垂眸。
他身上还有一些宝器，但是，一直典当宝器，也不是一个办法。
content_en:
Imperial soldiers are not particularly rare in Zhongzhou.
Especially low-level imperial soldiers.
Anyone with a little money can buy one.
It would be too poor to pawn one's treasures.
The more Fang Liqiu thought about Lin Xuan, the more rejection and disdain in his eyes almost overflowed, and he didn't even think that the other party would be someone he couldn't mess with.
joke.
Canglan City is not a big city.
The items in Linglong Pavilion are even more sparsely priced.
If you can't even afford a few pills, what are you a poor casual cultivator?
Not knowing what is good and what is bad is the other party’s problem!
Instead, Qin Meier's eyes suddenly lit up.
Her entire facial features instantly became vivid, she showed a mocking smile towards Fang Liqiu, and spoke with a smile.
"Hahaha, Fang Liqiu, your trick is only useful for your Fang family's dogs. Anyone with a bit of character will not eagerly come up to you and be driven by you. Do you really think that the spirit stone can do anything? It's ridiculous."
When she said this, Fang Liqiu was so angry that she gave her a look and walked away with a cold face.
Qin Mei'er was the only one left, and she snorted proudly as if she had won the battle.
But she didn't settle the matter and leave. Instead, she looked at the steward and knocked casually against the counter.
"Give me the treasure he left behind."
The steward did not dare to have any objections and handed over the treasure left by Lin Xuan.
The Pisces jade pendant has a milky white color that is moist throughout, shining under the sunlight. When you touch it, you can feel the man's cold body temperature.
Qin Meier's eyebrows were curved.
This guy is really interesting...
Would you rather break than bend?
She really wanted to get to know him.
Thinking about it, she waved her hand decisively, put away the jade pendant, and waved to the steward beside her who was hesitant to speak.
"Just deduct it from my monthly routine."
"I'll take this thing."
The corner of the red skirt brushed by a gust of fragrance and left, but the steward who was left alone felt relieved and nodded hurriedly.
"Yes."
"Congratulations, Miss Mei'er."
…
Lin Xuan, who left, didn't take this episode to heart at all.
But I have to say that the lack of spiritual stones is really a troublesome thing for him.
After returning to his temporary residence in Canglan City, Lin Xuan sat at the bluestone table with a locust tree in the courtyard, lowering his eyes slightly.
He still has some treasures on him, but keeping pawning the treasures is not an option.
